editorial.name: Heard
editorial.descriptionZh: 给 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 coding agent 加一层语音：把 agent 的进展念出来，也能用嘴回话。开源的 macOS 客户端，Pro 与 Power 是付费档。
editorial.takeawayZh: 让 coding agent 用语音汇报进度，还能语音回话
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是一片淡青色的山林远景，压着衬线大字 Get more done with your eyes off the screen，下面一行小字说 Heard is a voice notification and response layer for coding agents. It turns Claude Code and Codex activity into spoken updates you can answer.。右上角是 Product / Use Cases / For Teams / Pricing / Blog 和一颗黑色的 Download Heard。往下是 Multi-agent on the go 一行切换（Multi-agent、On the go、Talk back）和 Agent Brief 卡片，卡上写 Every active session, spoken back、Running now、Checked 2 Claude Code sessions、Summarized Codex progress。再下面是 BRIEF CONTROLS 的 Progress / Blockers / Decisions / Test results 四类信号，以及 CHOOSE HOW MUCH YOU WANT TO HEAR? 的 Quick Summary 与 Full story 两档。
editorial.pricing: Free open-source download; Heard Pro and Heard Power are paid

reasons.statement: 它交付的是开发工作流里的一层通知客户端（页脚有 Downloads 与 Documentation），站点自述 Heard is a voice notification and response layer for coding agents，产出不是设计素材或组件。
归 build-deploy-dev-workflow 是因为页面把 Claude Code / Codex 会话的进度、阻塞、决策、测试结果做成一份 brief，属于日常开发流程里的辅助环节；/compatibility 与 /docs 也印证它是工具而非设计资源。
